text: The word of God to my Lord: "Sit alongside me here on my throne until I make your enemies a stool for your feet."
now rule, though surrounded by enemies!
on the great day of your conquest, Join you at the fresh break of day, join you with all the vigor of youth.
you're the permanent priest, the Melchizedek priest.
crushing kings in his terrible wrath,
handing out convictions wholesale, crushing opposition across the wide earth.
the True King rules with head held high!
